conditional_clauses.note: Only where the client actually has a counter-claim. An empty counter-demand is worse than none.

mandatory_legal_checks: Civil Procedure Code 1908 Order VIII Rule 5 — an allegation not specifically denied is taken as admitted in a pleading; a court will ask why a now-disputed allegation went unanswered
Take every limitation, jurisdiction and arbitration objection NOW — a defence taken late reads as an afterthought
The reply commits the client to a version of events they will be cross-examined on; confine it to what the documents support
Limitation Act 1963 S.18 — do not acknowledge the other side's claim inadvertently
